title: Transaction Log Entry
description: One line of state/transactions.jsonl (PLAN.md §4 step 6 / §8): append-only, one JSON object per applied action (add/drop/trade/waiver claim).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transaction was applied.

team.description: Team slug the transaction was applied to (matches teams/<slug>).

action.description: Kind of transaction, e.g. 'add', 'drop', 'waiver_claim', 'trade'. 'free_agent' is a post-waiver signing (scripts/free_agency.py): bid 0, players [added, dropped].

players.description: Player ids involved (adds and drops together for a claim; both sides for a trade).

bid.description: FAAB dollars spent, or null when the action isn't a waiver claim (e.g. a free drop or trade).

reasoning.description: In-character reasoning logged with the transaction (from the agent's decision JSON, or the commissioner's ruling).

status.description: Outcome of the transaction as applied.
